actions.action: Decide how FLOOR.md clause iii and floor_core_changed should agree, then pin floor_anchor.py with clause-derived tests
actions.first_step: Read the #410 review comment and choose widen-the-classifier or narrow-the-clause
actions.done_when: Each FLOOR.md clause maps to a test written from its text, and floor_anchor.py mutation survivor density falls below 0.3
actions.scope_fence: Floor files: changes need the maintainer's out-of-band floor-signoff approval; no agent edits

actions.action: Add the clause-integrity and token-floor tests for floor_check.py from the #410 review, independent of REQUIRED_CLAUSES and MINIMUM_TOKEN_COUNT
actions.first_step: Write each test from FLOOR.md's sentence, not from the constants
actions.done_when: Deleting a REQUIRED_CLAUSES entry or lowering MINIMUM_TOKEN_COUNT turns a test red
actions.scope_fence: Tests only, under the same floor sign-off rule

actions.action: Split test_keyhole_signals.py into one test module per finding family, moving tests unchanged
actions.first_step: Move each finding family's tests into its own test_keyhole_<family>.py
actions.done_when: test_keyhole_signals.py is under 800 lines, its .file-size-ratchet.toml entry is removed, and the test count is unchanged
actions.scope_fence: Move tests only; no assertion or fixture logic changes
